page_title: MET 0-3 MAR | Metz v Marseille 04/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Flag up against Brian Madjo (Metz). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
90+5' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) volleys the ball towards goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great save to deny him attempt.
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.

90+4' What a sweet touch by Bilal Nadir (Marseille) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Jonathan Fischer to hold. Marseille will take a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Gauthier Hein (Metz) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
88' A spell of possession for Metz in an attempt to control the game.
85' Here is a change. Matt O'Riley is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Arthur Vermeeren (Marseille).
83' 3:3 – the corner kicks stats.
80' Substitution. Igor Paixao did his best and is replaced by Bilal Nadir (Marseille).
80' Substitution. Michael Murillo (Marseille) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Timothy Weah walks off.
79' We are about to witness a substitution. Brian Madjo (Metz) is replacing Habib Diallo.
79' Stephane Le Mignan has decided to substitute Fode Ballo-Toure and he is replaced by Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alpha Toure (Metz) comes onto the pitch so that Jessy Deminguet can be given a rest.

76' 0 - 3 An amazing individual effort from Amine Gouiri (Marseille) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 0:3. Jonathan Fischer was helpless.
73' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

72' A sweet pass finds Matt O'Riley (Marseille) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Jonathan Fischer is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Marseille force their opponents to concede a corner.

69' 0 - 2 It's in! Amine Gouiri spots his teammate in a good position on the edge of the box and provides him with a nice pass. Matt O'Riley (Marseille) doesn't think twice and rifles a first-time shot into the left side of the goal. The score is now 0:2.
65' The linesman signals that Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
65' A rebound spins to Timothy Weah (Marseille) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post.
64' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Angel Gomes will be replaced by Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille).
64' Robinio Vaz has picked up an injury and is replaced by Amine Gouiri (Marseille).
62' Robinio Vaz (Marseille) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
62' Great touch by Habib Diallo (Metz) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
61' Matt O'Riley (Marseille) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
60' Emerson (Marseille) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Clement Turpin has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
59' Koffi Kouao (Metz) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
57' Looks like Koffi Kouao (Metz) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

56' Emerson (Marseille) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
56' Marseille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
55' Timothy Weah (Marseille) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Marseille win a corner.
51' 0 - 1 Goal! Robinio Vaz passes the ball to Igor Paixao (Marseille) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Jonathan Fischer couldn't do anything about it. 0:1.
50' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity!
49' Gauthier Hein (Metz) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Geronimo Rulli gets down to his right to keep it out.
48' Igor Paixao (Marseille) fires a volley towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Metz comes to nothing.
47' Jessy Deminguet (Metz) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Metz force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
46' Referee Clement Turpin blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' The corner is swung in but Metz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+2' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Metz.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Poor challenge! Boubacar Traore (Metz) is penalised for tripping and Clement Turpin blows his whistle.
40' The possession of the ball – 40:60.
38' Robinio Vaz (Marseille) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Jonathan Fischer.
37' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
35' Metz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

35' Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play. Metz are awarded a corner kick.
33' Robinio Vaz (Marseille) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
32' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) is caught offside!
30' OFF THE POST! Good play from Mason Greenwood (Marseille) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes the right post!
29' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
26' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Clement Turpin blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
25' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

25' Igor Paixao (Marseille) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
24' A short pass finds Fode Ballo-Toure (Metz). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.

22' What a poor attempt! Emerson (Marseille) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
21' Jean-Philippe Gbamin is being substituted because of an injury. Stephane Le Mignan sends Maxime Colin (Metz) on the pitch.
18' Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
18' Robinio Vaz (Marseille) is able to continue to play.
15' Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Metz) picks up an injury.
15' Robinio Vaz (Marseille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
14' PENALTY APPEAL after Robinio Vaz (Marseille) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
11' The free kick evades the keeper and presents Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) with an almost open goal, but he somehow heads well wide of the right post from close in.
9' Angel Gomes (Marseille) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
5' Igor Paixao (Marseille) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
5' A neat pass is well received by Mason Greenwood (Marseille), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.

3' Angel Gomes (Marseille) clutches his head after wasting a good opportunity. He expertly collected the ball from a rebound and fired from long range, but his effort wasn't accurate at all and the ball went miles wide of the right post.
2' The game is interrupted. Koffi Kouao (Metz) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Marseille will kick-off.
Clement Turpin was nominated as the referee for this game.
